limitations: Public small synthetic tasks; single observed pair per domain, no statistical superiority, general cost saving or production reliability claim.
Automatic capture and explicit persistence are different estimands and are not pooled.
Reporting permits provenance-preserving paraphrase; museum explicitly requests necessary original wording.
Museum varies domain and independent authorship but retains the two-mode JSON topology; no longitudinal or arbitrary concurrency confirmation.

Reporting plain first-turn scoped-correction wording is imprecise; the same snapshot explicitly replaces unsettled state and asserts no prior accepted format, so it does not invent prior accepted history.

Final reading-only reporting repairs were made after handoff B1 freeze. Frozen B1 handoff harness remains unchanged; native transport bytes and handoff-consumed helper ASTs match. A separate two-turn same-S0 typo smoke checks the final reading path; malformed result/summary and wrong-identity boundaries remain offline calibration.

Task-token scan examines literal regular-file bytes in hidden project directories without following symlinks; it does not decompress Git objects. Per-turn snapshots cannot observe a write then deletion within the same tool call/turn, so this is not complete event or leakage auditing and has no malicious-subject security guarantee.
